unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፪ — Meraf 2: Advanced Foundations of ሐ and መ

success_screen.headline_en: Superb! You mastered the advanced levels of ሐ and መ!
success_screen.headline_am: በጣም ግሩም! የላቀውን የሐ እና የመ ፈተናዎች በባለሙያ ደረጃ አጠናቀቁ!

games.title: Word Assembly: ሐመር
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters to build the word for Ark / ship!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select the first form 'ሐ', then 'መ', and end with the sixth form 'ር'!

games.title: Word Finish: መኪና
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Car/Vehicle': መ[ ? ]ና. Choose the correct missing middle letter!
games.tips_en: The full word is መኪና (pronounced Me-ki-na).

games.title: Audio Blend: ሚ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the sound blend. Which symbol represents the exact 'Mie' sound you hear?
games.target_phonetic_description: The 3rd form ('Ie' vowel sound): 'Mie' as in 'Miz' (Banana)

games.title: Word Assembly: ሐሙስ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first form 'ሐ', second form 'ሙ', and end with sixth form 'ስ'!

games.title: Word Finish: መሶብ
games.instructions_en: Find the missing letter to complete the word for traditional food-basket: መ[ ? ]ብ.
games.tips_en: The full word is መሶብ (pronounced Me-sob).

games.title: Audio Blend: ሑ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely. Which symbol represents the 'Hu' sound with a loop on the middle-right leg?

games.title: Word Assembly: ሐኪም
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first form 'ሐ', third form 'ኪ', and end with sixth form 'ም'!

games.title: Word Finish: መርፌ
games.tips_en: The full word is መርፌ (pronounced Mer-fe).
